ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure shows a circle with K as the center, and G, L, H, J are all on the circumference. G is on the left side of the circle, J is on the right side, and segment GJ passes through the center K, so GJ is a diameter. H is located at the upper right of the circle, and L is located at the lower left of the circle. In the figure, the central angle ∠GKH formed by the two radii from K to G and from K to H is labeled 122°. Reasoning: The measure of a central angle is equal to the measure of the corresponding minor arc it intercepts, so the measure of minor arc GH is 122°. The problem asks for m arc GLH, that is, the arc from G to H and passing through L; this is not minor arc GH, but the major arc complementary to minor arc GH. Therefore m arc GLH = 360° - 122° = 238°.

raw_record.question_text: $\overline{GJ}$ is a diameter of $\odot K$. Find $m\widehat{GLH}$.

method.method_draft: Read the diagram as a circle centered at K with G, L, H, J on the circumference. The marked central angle at K is ∠GKH = 122°, so the minor arc GH measures 122°. The requested arc GLH is the arc from G to H that passes through L, which is the major arc complementary to minor arc GH. Compute 360° − 122° = 238°.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中是一个以 K 为圆心的圆，G、L、H、J 都在圆周上。G 在圆的左侧，J 在右侧，线段 GJ 经过圆心 K，所以 GJ 是直径。H 位于圆的右上方，L 位于圆的左下方。图中从 K 到 G 和从 K 到 H 的两条半径形成的中心角 ∠GKH 标为 122°。

推理：中心角的度数等于它所截的对应小弧的度数，所以小弧 GH 的度数是 122°。题目要求 m弧 GLH，即从 G 到 H 且经过 L 的那条弧；这不是小弧 GH，而是与小弧 GH 互补的优弧。因此 m弧 GLH = 360° - 122° = 238°。
